title: samplebox~
description: `samplebox~` records and plays back a sound, with controls for playback start and end points, reading speed, phase, channel switching, and modifying sections using block flipping or swapping. `samplebox~ 2067` creates an initially three-second buffer at a 44.1 kHz sample rate and 64-sample block size, since its argument is calculated as duration × sample rate ÷ block size.
